notes: HE 0437-5439: Included as follow_up because this paper cites Edelmann et al. (2005) and analyzes the already-measured rotation of this hypervelocity star (T:p6-b1; T:p8-b0); the “HE” arrow in I:p8-b0 refers to the same object. The paper notes a possible LMC origin as a complicating factor but makes no new boundness determination, so follow_up applies regardless of its current boundness conclusion.

HE 0437-5439: HE 0437-5439 is discussed at T:p6-b1, where the only numerical stellar property reported is its projected rotational velocity V sin i = 54 ± 4 km/s. That quantity is not among the requested identifiers. T:p8-b0 and I:p8-b0 mention that its measured radial velocity is used as a lower limit on the ejection velocity V∞, but no numerical radial velocity is given; therefore no requested quantity can be extracted without adding unsupported information.
